meta.title: xidker — Ready-made portfolio website source code
meta.description: Buy the source code of a finished personal portfolio website. Add your name, projects and photos, then put it online. Pay by bank transfer with a QR code.

hero.title: A ready-made portfolio website. Buy the source, add your work, go live.
hero.sub: Skip designing from scratch. You get the full source of an animated portfolio site — drop in your name, projects and photos, and publish it.
hero.heroAlt: Pixel character standing at the start line

what.title: What are you buying?
what.body: The complete source code of a personal portfolio website, already designed and built. It's yours to keep and change however you like.
points: A finished design, not a template sketch
Content kept separate, so it's easy to find and replace
Ready to use as soon as your details are in

pages.title: What pages are included?
pages.body: Everything a recruiter or client looks for when they open your link.
items: A home page that says who you are
A grid of your best projects
A detail page for every project

motion.title: It moves. It's not a static page.
motion.body: Just like the page you're on: scroll effects and small moving details that make people want to reach the end. If a visitor has reduced motion turned on, the site holds still.
points: Looks right on phones and desktops
Nothing to install to view it
Text and images first, effects after

how.title: What happens after you buy?
steps: Create an account, pick a package, then scan the QR code to pay by bank transfer.
Once the money arrives, we confirm your order and email you. The source waits in your account, ready to download any time.
Download it and swap in your name, projects and photos.
Publish it on any host you like, then send the link to recruiters or clients.

who.title: Who is it for?
who.body: Anyone who needs one link to send with a CV or a quote.

pricing.title: Pick your source package
pricing.sub: Prices are in Vietnamese dong (VND). You pay by bank transfer with a QR code, no card needed.

items.q: Where do I get the source after paying?
items.a: Once your transfer arrives and the order is confirmed, a download button appears in your account, and we email you too. Can't find the email? Check spam, or message us in the support chat.

items.q: I'm not a coder. Can I still use it?
items.a: Yes. Your name, bio, projects and photos are kept in one place, and the README walks you through each step. Rather not touch code? Pick Custom Build or All-in-One A–Z: send us your requirements and we build it for you.

items.q: How many portfolios does one package cover?
items.a: Each package builds 1 portfolio. Need more than one? Buy a package for each portfolio.

items.q: How do I put it online?
items.a: With All-in-One A–Z, we put it online for you, with hosting and a domain name included for 1 year. With the other packages, pick any web host and upload the source; the README shows you how. We don't lock you into a platform.

items.q: What if something's broken or missing?
items.a: Email us with what went wrong and the email you bought with. We'll look into it and get back to you.
Refunds are only possible before your order is confirmed. Once the source has been sent and the support chat is closed, all refund options are void. Please keep this in mind before you buy.
